To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the parallelism inherent to logic programs makes it possible to realize a highly parallel computer architecture, and that (2) a highly parallel computer can be used to implement the knowledge information processing of logic programs, thereby realizing a knowledge information processing machine.

logic programming is a programming paradigm that can be used to implement the knowledge information processing system of the fifth generation computer, and that the knowledge information processing of the fifth generation is the “bridge" connecting logic programming with parallel computer architecture.
the logic programming language is the “bridge”, the logic programming language Prolog is the “bridge material”, and that the logic programming system is the “bridge construction”.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following topics: 1) the design of logic programming languages which are suitable for parallel computers, 2) the design of parallel computers suitable for logic programming, 3) the development of a parallel logic programming language, PROLOG-III, which can run efficiently on parallel computers, 4) the development of an experimental parallel computer, the TR-4, which can execute PROLOG-III programs in a parallel way, and 5) the development of the Fifth Generation computer, TR

a parallel computer architecture based on a parallel logic programming system, which is a parallel implementation of a logic programming language, and a logic programming system which is based on a parallel computer architecture.
the development of logic programming as a programming language for the Fifth Generation Computer System.

the Fifth Generation Computer is the first computer that is based on logic.
logic programming is a “natural” language for expressing the knowledge and information processing required for the Fifth Generation Computer System.
we have found that the Fifth Generation Computer is the bridge between knowledge information processing and logic programming.

we have succeeded in constructing the “bridge” which connects the two worlds.

logic programming is not only a language, but also a methodology for building knowledge information systems and a methodology for building parallel computers.
logic programming is an ideal vehicle to express parallelism.
